footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Itaú Unibanco: includes a R$4.4B income tax benefit; after R$992M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. No per-share figures were reported for these years.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 0.2% to R$167.8B in 2025. Operating income rose 12.9% to R$41.4B, a 24.7% margin.
